review_notes: I read the whole file. It has no `@[simp]` declarations, so I looked for missing simp lemmas and for repeated manual simp sets. The one concrete gap is that conjugation `U.toLinearMap ∘ₗ S ∘ₗ U.symm.toLinearMap` has no canonical pointwise rewrite. As a result, the same three-lemma `simp only` set is retyped here and elsewhere in the repo (grep hits in KyFan.lean, Polar/Decomposition.lean and others). I checked Mathlib's `LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toLinearEquiv` and `LinearEquiv.coe_coe`, both of which are simp lemmas. I did not find an existing lemma that directly normalises `⇑U.toLinearMap` for a `LinearIsometryEquiv`, but I searched only the LinearIsometry file, so one may exist elsewhere. Nothing was compiled, so the proposed lemma is untested. I did not recommend simp attributes on the other small identities, such as the private re-inner lemmas or `eigenvalues_conj_unitary`. They have no demonstrated rewrite need.

findings.problem: The unitary conjugation `U.toLinearMap ∘ₗ S ∘ₗ U.symm.toLinearMap` has no canonical pointwise simp form. Every proof that unfolds it must spell out the same three-lemma `simp only` set (`LinearMap.comp_apply`, `LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toLinearEquiv`, `LinearEquiv.coe_coe`). This file does so at lines 392, 415, 420 and 440. The same trio is repeated in KyFan.lean (lines 81, 91) and other files. The coercion `⇑U.toLinearMap` passes through `toLinearEquiv` and then `coe_coe`, so there is no single rule saying `⇑U.toLinearMap = ⇑U` for `U : E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] E`. The desired normal form `U (S (U.symm x))` therefore depends on remembering the list.
findings.proposed_change: Add two lemmas next to `isSymmetric_conj_unitary`. First, `@[simp] theorem LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toLinearMap_eq (U : E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] E) : ⇑U.toLinearMap = ⇑U := rfl`, or an equivalent normaliser that bundles `coe_toLinearEquiv` and `coe_coe`. Second, `@[simp] theorem conj_unitary_apply (S : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) (U : E ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] E) (x : E) : (U.toLinearMap ∘ₗ S ∘ₗ U.symm.toLinearMap) x = U (S (U.symm x))`. The rewrite goes toward the smaller, constructor-free term, so it cannot cycle. Then `simp [conj_unitary_apply]` or plain `simp` replaces the explicit lists at lines 392, 415, 420 and 440. It would also replace the matching ones in KyFan.lean.
findings.benefit: Readers and downstream proofs get one stable normal form for unitary conjugation. Proofs stop depending on a hand-maintained trio of lemma names. A future change in how `LinearIsometryEquiv` coerces would need one fix instead of many scattered `simp only` lists.
